description: Image of O'Keeffe with her back to the viewer pulling open the curtains on the large plate glass window in her Abiquiu house studio; she is dressed in a black wrap dress and her Hector Aguilar silver and suede belt with her hair pulled back into a bun; canisters and glass jars full of paint brushes, boxes of paints and artist materials on long wooden shelf-like table in front of the window, GOK painting on the wall:  It Was Red And Pink, 1959.
title: O'Keeffe opening the curtains of her studio
